verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both directions of cross-device handoff. Remote Control lets you step away from your desk and keep working from your phone or any browser. Tasks started on the web or the Claude mobile app can be pulled into the terminal with `claude --teleport`, and cloud sessions can be kicked off and checked on later. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that handoff works reliably, and deeper documentation of how session state and context carry over, plus any limitations.
